reply.text:
Wanting to see your ribs and eating less to get there is a place I won't help you push toward. I'm not going to give you tips for eating less, and I'm not setting up targets or a plan around that goal. It's one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can look at the whole picture with you.

Hunger is also your body asking for fuel, and training well depends on answering it. Once you've had that conversation, I'm glad to build the training side with you, whether that's getting stronger, building muscle, or running.
